editorial:
Imagine living in a quiet neighborhood where nothing ever happens, only to have your peace ruined by the weirdest neighbors ever. You follow a normal family with a teenage daughter who starts noticing creepy things happening around her house. Everything changes when a woman and a strange little girl move in next door. The vibe is super tense because you spend a lot of time staring at grainy camera footage, waiting for something to move in the background. It feels like you are spying on these people, which makes the jump scares hit way harder than usual.

What really works here is how the movie builds up the dread before the big chaos at the end. The acting feels natural, and the way they use the cameras keeps you guessing. While some parts might feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it for horror fans. You should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you love owning your films, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep the scares forever.
endingExplained: You find out that the woman next door is actually Katie, and the little girl is Hunter, who is now possessed. In the final scenes, the demon takes over and attacks the family in their own home. Katie tries to warn them, but it is too late. The movie ends with a huge shock where the demon kills the parents and captures the daughter, leaving you wondering if anyone will ever be safe from the curse.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves jump scares and found-footage movies.
